name: Bag of Tricks (Rust)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Pull out a creature
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: throw a fuzzy ball up to 20 ft; it becomes a random Beast that fights for you until dawn.

summary: 3 charges: pull out a fuzzy ball that becomes a random Beast friendly to you (rat, owl, mastiff, and others).
text: The rust cloth bag seems empty, but feel around inside and you find a small fuzzy object. It holds 3 charges and regains 1d3 spent charges each dawn. As a Magic action while holding the bag, spend 1 charge to draw out the fuzzy object and toss it up to 20 feet; where it lands it becomes a creature, chosen by a d8 roll on the bag's table (1 rat, 2 owl, 3 mastiff, 4 goat, 5 giant goat, 6 giant boar, 7 lion, 8 brown bear). The creature regards you and your allies as friends and takes its turn right after yours. With a Bonus Action you can tell it where to go and which action to use on its next turn, or hand it broader instructions; left without orders, it behaves as its nature dictates. It vanishes once it drops to 0 Hit Points or when dawn next arrives.
